_comment: Example AssetExplorer UDF api_name -> friendly column-label map. UDF labels are deployment-specific; this map was recovered for one Vodacom Tanzania AssetExplorer instance by correlating an AE report export against the adapter's AE001 pull. Point AE_UDF_LABELS at this file (AE_UDF_LABELS=@config/assetexplorer_udf_labels.example.json) or paste the JSON inline, so the custom.udf_* columns render as readable names. Copy and adjust for your own instance; the adapter also tries to read these labels from AssetExplorer's field metadata automatically.
